title: Right vs. Right: Can LLMs Make Tough Choices?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to a dataset of 1,730 ethical dilemmas involving four pairs of conflicting moral values (Truth vs. Loyalty, Individual vs. Community, Short-Term vs. Long-Term, Justice vs. Mercy) using variations in prompt formulation, inclusion of action consequences, and explicit or implicit preference alignment instructions.
